info.description: Personal life management API. Money amounts are decimal strings.

database.description: Whether the database answered a trivial query.

balance.description: Derived from the opening balance and all records (ADR 0011).

openingBalance.description: May be negative, e.g. a credit card that starts with debt.

amount.description: In the record currency; always positive.

id.description: Client-generated. Keep it when editing so the line keeps its identity.

amount.description: In the record currency; must be positive.

fxRate.description: Required for foreign-currency records; omit for TWD.

twdAmount.description: Whole TWD. Omit to calculate it from amount × fxRate; set it to match a statement.

counterAmount.description: Transfer only: the amount received, in the receiving account currency.

lines.description: One or more for income/expense; exactly one for a transfer; none for an adjustment.

budgetItemId.description: The stable item id (ADR 0012). New ids create items.

amount.description: Whole TWD per cadence period. Anchor `amount` only.

carryToItemId.description: For `onReset: carry`: an item in this version.

effectiveFromMonth.description: The first month this version applies to.

toItemId.description: Null only for a stored reset that dropped the leftover.

fromItemId.description: The budget item the amount leaves.

toItemId.description: The budget item that receives it.

resetsOn.description: The end of the current reset cycle; null if it never resets.

carryIn.description: Carried in from earlier periods (negative = overspent).

transfers.description: Net budget transfers in this period, resets carried in included.

spent.description: Spent in this period, up to the report date.

planned.description: Planned for the period; pre-fills batch entry.

recorded.description: Recorded in the period, on the item and its descendants.

done.description: True once any line is recorded.

netIncome.description: Gross income minus Government: the default base.

transfers.description: Net budget transfers in the month, computed resets included.

planned.description: Planned for the whole year, across versions.

actual.description: Actual from January to the end of this month.

transfers.description: Net budget transfers in the month, computed resets included.

income.description: Income on no item, or on an item outside this version.

expense.description: Spending on no item, or on an item outside this version.

sections.description: Totals of the top-level items, in section order.

items.description: In plan order. A parent's transfers and actual include its descendants'.

toItemId.description: Null when a reset drops the leftover.
